notes.status: Engineering defaults. NOT tuned on real video; no identity-labeled real footage exists. Choose final values on a development set and record them before comparing candidates.
notes.gate_chi2: chi-square 0.99 quantile, 4 degrees of freedom (cx, cy, w, h).
notes.R: Measurement noise comes from box size (fractions of w/h with a pixel floor), not from detector confidence; no validated confidence-to-R method exists.
notes.timeouts: All lifecycle timeouts are seconds, not frames. Tentative tracks survive misses up to tentative_timeout_s; confirmed tracks coast as 'lost' for max_coast_s.
notes.duplicate_iou: Two same-class detections with IoU >= this in one frame are treated as one (lower score dropped).
